item.title: IDF and Shin Bet eliminate Hamas sniper in Khan Yunis
item.description:
The IDF and Shin Bet struck in the Khan Yunis area on Thursday, eliminating the terrorist Tamer Hamaida, who served as a sniper in the Hamas terrorist organization.
Throughout the war, the terrorist advanced terror and sniper attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and worked to restore the terrorist organization’s capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated in an aerial strike.

item.title: Supreme Court unanimously overturns decision to disqualify Joint List
item.description:
The Supreme Court unanimously accepted the Joint List's appeal and overturned the Central Elections Committee's decision to disqualify it from running in the elections for the 26th Knesset.
The justices ruled that the materials submitted to the Central Elections Committee did not meet the legal standards established by case law for disqualifying a list of candidates.
